GUIDE FOR THE PREPARATION OF BIBLIOGRAPHlC DESCRIPTION SHEET FOR TECHNICAL REPORTS
0. FOREWORD
0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 11 January 1980, after the draft finalized by the Documentation Sectional Committee had been approved by the Executive Committee. 0.2 Technical reports form a distinctive type of document generated by a large number of institutions and organizations. These reports facilitate rapid communication and exchange of scientific and technical information. In India, the number of institutions and organizations and the number of reports generated by them have been increasing rapidly during the past two decades. It is desirable that appropriate mechanism be developed and utilized for the convenient bibliographic control of these reports. 0.3 The provision of a bibliographic description sheet in the report helps in bibliographic control and facilitates the processing of the document for library and documentation services. It will ensure consistency, uniformity and compatibility in the documentation of the reports. Appendix A gives a proforma for the sheet. The proforma should be completed and bound as the first sheet of the report. 0.3.1 Copies of the completed bibliographic description sheet ( for declassified and unclassified reports ) may be prepared by the issuing authority and sent to a library, documentation centre or to other agencies to facilitate notification by them as a part of their SDI/alert service. 1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard specifies the data elements graphic description sheet. 2. DATA ELEMENTS AND LAYOUT and layout for a biblio-

2.1 A bibliographic description sheet containing data elements and its layout are given in Appendix A. Appendix B illustrates a filled-in description sheet. 3

3.5 Report Type ( 05 ) - The type of the report should be indicated using an appropriate term suitably abbreviated, such as Technical Note ( TN ), Technical Memorandum ( TM ), Survey Report ( SR ), Conference Report ( CR ), Project Rrport ( PR ), Project Evaluation Report ( PE ), Research Report ( RR ), and Inspection KepW NR ). 3.6 Part No. or Volume No. ( 07 ) - Technical reports issued in parts or volumes may be indicated by two-digit numbers. The numerator in the notation denotes that particular part or volume number and the denominator the total number of parts or volumes of the technical reports ( for example, 01/04, 02/04, 03/04, 04/04 ).
